name: Checkout Gateway for Paddle
author: GrandPlugins

sections.description:
Checkout Gateway for Paddle adds Paddle as a payment gateway to WooCommerce, allowing you to sell products using Paddle’s secure hosted checkout.

The plugin connects your WooCommerce store with Paddle, automatically creating Paddle checkouts from WooCommerce orders and syncing customer, product, and pricing data during checkout.

This is ideal for stores that want to use Paddle for tax handling, and global payments while continuing to manage products inside WooCommerce.

Features

  • Paddle Checkout integration for WooCommerce
  • Supports one-time products
  • Secure hosted checkout handled by Paddle
  • Automatic checkout creation from WooCommerce orders
  • Simple setup using Paddle API credentials

for additional features in pro

Pro 👈

✅ Allow recurring products checkout
✅ Allow checkout from single product page and shop / archive pages
✅ Create and Update Paddle products and prices from WooCommerce products pages
✅ Auto Sync prices between WooCommerce and Paddle products
✅ Allow generating Paddle products and prices on the fly at checkout
✅ List and edit Paddle subscriptions list from WooCommerce site.
✅ Paddle Subscription and transaction checkout shortcodes
✅ WooCommerce Subscription and PMPRO integration
✅ WooCommerce Checkout Block Integration

External Services

This plugin connects to the Paddle API to create and manage checkout sessions.

During checkout, the plugin sends:
* Paddle API credentials
* Product information (title, description, pricing)
* Customer billing and shipping details

This data is required to generate Paddle checkout sessions and process payments.

Paddle privacy policy: https://www.paddle.com/legal/privacy
Paddle terms of service: https://www.paddle.com/legal/terms
